name: Weapon bench
css: .astra-window{padding:16px;gap:14px;background:radial-gradient(120% 70% at 0% 0%,rgba(237,188,99,.10),transparent 46%),#12161c}.bench-head{gap:4px}.bench-head::before{content:"Weapon bench";display:block;font-size:18px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.2}.bench-head::after{content:"Select a part to see if it fits. Install accepts a direct fit. Remove puts the fitted part back. Clean clears fouling. Calibrate restores the zero.";display:block;max-width:36em;color:#9aa3b2;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45}.bench-status{margin:0;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);color:#d5dbe6;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4}.astra-list{flex:1;min-height:0;gap:6px;padding:2px}.astra-list-row{border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;background:#1c232e;padding:10px 12px;text-align:left;transition:background .12s ease,border-color .12s ease}.astra-list-row:hover:not(:disabled){background:#262e3c;border-color:#3c4658}.astra-list-row.is-selected{outline:none;background:#2c2618;border-color:#edbc63;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 #edbc63}.astra-list-row:disabled,.astra-list-row:disabled:hover{opacity:1;color:#8b93a3;background:#171c24;border-color:#2a3140;cursor:default}.bench-actions{margin-top:2px;gap:8px}.bench-actions button{flex:1;min-height:40px;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:.01em;transition:background .12s ease,border-color .12s ease,transform .12s ease}button.bench-primary{background:#edbc63;color:#1a1408;border-color:#edbc63}button.bench-primary:hover{background:#f3cc7e;border-color:#f3cc7e}button.bench-primary:active,button.bench-primary.is-pressed{background:#c9963a;border-color:#c9963a}button.bench-quiet{background:transparent;color:#e7ecf5;border-color:#3c4658}button.bench-quiet:hover{background:#262e3c;border-color:#d7deea}button.bench-quiet:active,button.bench-quiet.is-pressed{background:#1a1408;border-color:#edbc63}button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #edbc63;outline-offset:2px}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){button,.astra-list-row{transition:none}}
